current_bottleneck: The minimal endpoint-conditioned bridge is mathematically clean but empirically failed as a primary route: endpoint conditioning preserved validity and broad coverage, yet the transition law produced uneven per-cell move scales, weak multi-horizon conditionality, poor unconditional level occupancy, and poor pathwise max-jump geometry.
last_result_summary: 481a trained and evaluated at results/block_ar/481a_endpoint_bridge_s42/full11.json. It reached 4/11, passing surface validity, block-AR smoothness, cointegration, and cross-cell correlation, while failing coverage, conditionality, time-series properties, regime coverage, distributional fidelity, mean reversion, and pathwise jump realism. Key failures: conditionality MAE reduction 0.7%, level KS 1/25, daily KS 7/25, kurtosis ratio 0.415, active mean-reversion pass 47.5%, and pathwise max-jump KS 0.784.
next_step_recommendation: Do not add bridge-specific knobs such as endpoint hard projection, coarse knots, support codebooks, or per-cell temperature patches. Run post-experiment analysis / ideation around why 392a remains the 8/11 deployable frontier while clean learned path-law attempts underperform.
